target_fidelity.note: It is an active, positive, past simple polar question with no modal.

naturalness.note: The prompt and resulting question are coherent and natural.

pedagogical_suitability.note: It provides focused practice forming a past simple yes/no question.

determinacy.note: The cue phrase and context clearly determine the accepted question.

non_target_language_simplicity.note: The vocabulary and context are common and transparent.

no_answer_leakage.note: The prompt gives only the phrase to use, not the completed question form.

no_extraneous_grammar.note: Solving it requires only past simple question formation.
